acceptanceCriteria: The three Core workflows pass on Corvint, Beamfall and at least one untouched external repository.
Cases are frozen before execution and no implementation tuning follows unsealing without invalidating the candidate.
Failures, exclusions, retries and unsupported scope remain in the promotion packet.
body: Validate the immutable candidate on an untouched external repository after internal dogfood has passed.
title: Validate the release candidate on untouched repositories
